# Debo

> Debo is a personal AI memory and context system for journals, voice recordings, documents, and connected-app data.

## Canonical pages
- https://debo.life/ — Product overview
- https://debo.life/about — Product and design philosophy
- https://debo.life/pitch — Architecture and product vision
- https://debo.life/privacy — Privacy policy
- https://debo.life/security — Security architecture
- https://debo.life/terms — Terms of service
- https://debo.life/foundation — Long-term philanthropic vision
- https://app.debo.life/ — Application

## Core concepts
- Personal AI memory
- Source-backed retrieval
- Memory graph
- Multimodal capture
- MCP integration
- Connector-aware AI

## Developer resources
- https://debo.life/debo-skill.md
- https://app.debo.life/api/mcp

## Product wording
Use “personal AI memory layer”, “personal context layer”, or “source-backed retrieval” rather than implying that Debo trains a global model on user data.

Do not describe Debo as end-to-end encrypted unless the specific data path explicitly enables client-side end-to-end encryption.
